method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, forward replay of all three displayed derivations, reverse paraphrase of both strategy discussions, and exact formula, macro, token, label, reference-option and identifier comparison; no independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Three propositional examples using axiom instances and modus ponens, the general chaining proposition and concatenation proof, and a three-item derivation exercise.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: To derive not-D-or-E implies D-implies-E, choose an ax:lor3 instance whose two antecedent conditionals come from ax:lnot2 and ax:lif1, then apply modus ponens twice.
samples.checks: The assignments A = not-D, B = E and C = D-implies-E, the three axiom references, the two modus-ponens steps and all five derivation lines remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A direct ax:lif1 strategy for D-implies-D fails because it would require deriving D alone. Instead, instantiate ax:lif2 with A and C equal to D and choose B as D-implies-D; two ax:lif1 instances and two modus-ponens steps then yield the identity conditional.
samples.checks: The failed strategy is not presented as a proof, the successful choice of B is preserved, and every displayed formula and five-line justification sequence is unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: From Gamma containing A-implies-B and B-implies-C, a seven-line derivation obtains A-implies-C; Hyp marks the two formulas that are elements of Gamma.
samples.checks: Both hypotheses, ax:lif1, ax:lif2, the three modus-ponens applications, the Hyp gloss and membership direction are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If Gamma derives A-implies-B and B-implies-C, concatenate those derivations, append lines 3 through 7 of the preceding pattern, and replace references to lines 1 and 2 by references to the last lines of the two component derivations.
samples.checks: The proposition's two premises and conclusion, derivation order, appended line range, final-line claim and both line-reference substitutions remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The exercise asks for explicit derivations from the axioms of conjunction commutation, a curried conditional, and one direction of a De Morgan implication.
samples.checks: All three target formulas and the requirement to exhibit axiomatic derivations are preserved.

source_observations: The identity example deliberately retains the unsuccessful first strategy before giving the successful ax:lif2 construction.
The chaining proof is a meta-level construction from arbitrary component derivations, not merely the preceding seven-line special case; the Marathi preserves that distinction.
No formula, macro, token, label, identifier, reference option or proof-line justification was changed.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
समर्थित and सिद्धतायोग्य follow the existing definition-controlled proof vocabulary, while जोडणी follows the recorded didactic term with the formal alternative retained in the terminology ledger.
The section will enter a cumulative reader only after the axiomatic-deduction chapter is complete.
